sections.content: <div> is the generic block container; <span> is the generic inline container. Neither adds meaning — they exist purely for CSS/JS grouping.
Reach for semantic tags first (nav, article, section); use div/span only when no semantic element fits. This keeps pages accessible and stylesheets sane.
Key points: div = block (new line), span = inline (flows with text), and class names should describe purpose (.card, .nav-link) not appearance (.red-box).
